identity.real_world_identity_notes: The exact Toyota identity is established by AMS2 telemetry. Official 2024 series regulations define the common prescribed platform and paddle-shift transmission hardware.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed GT-style rim with an integrated display and wheel-mounted shift lights.

notes: With the tested assists disabled, the engine stalled when moving from rest without physical clutch input.
Six paddle-selected gears, clutchless no-lift upshifts, and clutchless downshifts with automatic blip were directly established.
Automatic cut is a medium-confidence manual observation based on a brief throttle-graph interruption during an upshift while pedal input was maintained.
Guided test completed in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch and Auto Shifting disabled.
Standing-start clutch, six paddle gears, automatic blip, and the closed display rim with shift lights were directly observed.
Automatic cut was manually confirmed from a brief throttle-graph interruption; the guided detector did not establish it confidently.

confidence.basis: Exact identity and most user-facing controls were directly verified; official series regulations support the common paddle-shift hardware. Automatic cut is a separately disclosed medium-confidence manual telemetry-graph observation.

claims.basis: Official season addition and exact live telemetry establish the Toyota identity and simulator class.
